title: Wall-crossing formula and genus-one Virasoro conjecture for Fano complete intersections
summary: The Virasoro conjecture predicts a set of universal relations among all genera Gromov--Witten invariants of any smooth projective variety. The conjecture is well understood for semisimple theories, but remains largely open in the non-semisimple setting. We prove the genus-one Virasoro conjecture on the ambient state space of smooth Fano complete intersections in projective space. For most of these complete intersections, the big quantum cohomology is nowhere semisimple.
